layout.body:
Dear Students,
The school computer lab will be closed this Friday for system upgrades. During this time, you may use the computers in the library instead. All files saved on lab computers have been backed up and will be available again on Monday. Please plan your work accordingly.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of this notice?
questions.analysis: What is the main purpose of this notice? 原文依据：The school computer lab will be closed this Friday for system upgrades. 学校计算机实验室本周五因系统升级将关闭。 A：宣布新的电脑使用规定 → 错误 B：告知实验室关闭 → 正确 C：介绍图书馆开放时间 → 错误 D：征求学生反馈 → 错误

questions.stem: Where can students use computers on Friday?
questions.analysis: Where can students use computers on Friday? 原文依据：During this time, you may use the computers in the library instead. 在此期间，你可以使用图书馆的电脑。 A：在教室 → 错误 B：在图书馆 → 正确 C：在家 → 错误 D：在食堂 → 错误
